title: Transport of the ordinary derived tensor comparison
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, with A and B R-algebras and C an E=A tensor_R B algebra, and derived categories of R- and B-modules. Let K,L be A-module cochain complexes, n,i integers, e:L ≅ K[-n], and mK a model of K as in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Put F_E equal to termwise extension A→E and let eOrd:H^(i+n)(F_E L) ≅ H^i(F_E K) be the isomorphism from F_E(e), its canonical shift isomorphism and the prescribed homology shift. There exist a model mL of L and an E-linear isomorphism eT:mL.cohomology(i+n) ≅ mK.cohomology(i) such that mL.comparison(i+n) followed by eOrd equals eT followed by mK.comparison(i). No localized comparison square or isomorphism of a comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tags 06Y6 (derived extension is exact), 08IB (affine ordinary comparison), 05SU (derived shifts), 0DJA(1) (tensor inheritance); shift compatibility here is an agent-written algebraic ingredient, not a verbatim assertion of Tag 0DJA

proof.text: Keep mK.derived and its counit. Apply the proved coherent right Kan shift theorem to mK.universal, obtaining CommShift on derived and shift compatibility of counit.

Define D as restriction to R, homotopy quotient, Qh, and derived. For each j compose D(e), D.commShiftIso and the derived homology shift into delta(j). Set cohomology(j)=mK.cohomology(j-n) and cohomologyIso(j)=mK.cohomologyIso(j-n) followed by delta(j).inv. Naturality for a times identity and the fact that cochain shift preserves scalar multiplication prove the scalar-action field; cancel delta(j).hom and use mK.cohomologyIso_smul.

Use the proved ordinary tensor associativity isomorphism for L and its generator formula. Define epsilon(j) explicitly using F(e), F.commShiftIso, and ordinary homology shift. Define comparison(j)=mK.comparison(j-n) followed by epsilon(j).inv. Apply the B-linear counit shift square. Compose comparison_eq for K with its restriction homology isomorphism; cancel the restriction homology isomorphism for L and U(epsilon(j).hom). This proves exactly comparison_eq for L.

Construct ordinaryToLocalized by transposing the extension unit for the composite coefficient map, composed with restrictScalarsComp. Its value on a pure tensor is g(e) tensor x. Define localizedComparison by transposing comparison followed by homology of ordinaryToLocalized and the restriction homology isomorphism. The homEquiv inverse identity gives localized_eq; fill all model fields with these explicit data.

For arbitrary j,k with j-n=k, substitute k and cancel epsilon(j).inv followed by epsilon(j).hom. Specialize j=i+n,k=i and use the eqToIso between reindexed cohomology objects. This proves the required ordinary comparison square. No compatibility of localizedComparison with shifts is claimed.

from.place: Tensor inheritance in the single-complex base-change criterion: transport of the ordinary derived comparison in the shift reduction (Tag 0DJA(1)).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_baseDerivedTensor_ordinary_shift_model
    (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (n : ℤ) (e : L ≅ K⟦-n⟧)
    (mK : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B K C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B))).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)
    let eH := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B))
      (.up ℤ) (i + n)).mapIso (F.mapIso e ≪≫ (F.commShiftIso (-n)).app K) ≪≫
      (CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{u} (A ⊗[R] B)) (-n) (i + n) i
        (by omega)).app (F.obj K)
    ∃ (mL : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B L C)
      (eT : mL.cohomology (i + n) ≅ mK.cohomology i),
      mL.comparison (i + n) ≫ eH.hom = eT.hom ≫ mK.comparison i
